skills.name: chameleon-robyn
skills.description: Render Chameleon page templates (.pt files using TAL and METAL) from Robyn web handlers. A handler returns a dict and the @template decorator turns it into a Robyn Response. Use when adding Chameleon templates to a Robyn app, when a handler should return a dict that becomes an HTML page, when a ChameleonRobynException or a Chameleon ValueError, NameError or KeyError appears while rendering, when choosing between @template, response(), render() and ChameleonTemplate, when a 404 page or a cookie must be set on a rendered page, or when Alpine.js or htmx attributes fail to parse in a template.
